title: Session auth hardening: signed session tokens
description: Currently mc_session cookie stores plaintext username (SPEC §9 known limitation). Replace with: (1) Add sessions table (id UUID, username, created_at, expires_at), (2) On login, create session row and set mc_session=<uuid>, (3) AuthedUser extractor looks up UUID in sessions table, (4) On logout, delete session row. This prevents cookie forgery.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] sessions table created in migration
- [ ] Login creates session with UUID token
- [ ] Cookie contains UUID, not username
- [ ] AuthedUser validates UUID against sessions table
- [ ] Logout deletes session
- [ ] Expired sessions ignored (TTL configurable, default 24h)
- [ ] Meaningful commit referencing this issue id
- [ ] git push to master
notes: [dispatch] Signed session tokens (no plaintext cookie). AC: login sets signed token; unauthorized redirects; unit test; git push/PR; evidence in bd comment.

See ADR-006. May need to reverse-engineer Gateway WS protocol or wait for docs.

- [ ] cron::toggle enables/disables jobs via RPC
- [ ] cron::run_now triggers immediate execution via RPC
